title: Network initiated transport of NAS messages

entities.name: Network initiated transport of NAS messages
entities.description: Procedure where the MME initiates transport of application messages encapsulated in NAS messages to the UE.

entities.name: DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: NAS message sent by MME to transport application messages to the UE.

entities.name: Generic message container
entities.description: IE containing the application message to be transported.

entities.name: Generic message container type
entities.description: IE indicating the application protocol used in the generic transport.

entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: Optional IE containing additional information requested by the application.

entities.name: EMM entity in MME
entities.description: EMM entity in the MME that initiates the transport procedure.

entities.name: EMM entity in UE
entities.description: EMM entity in the UE that receives the transport message and provides contents to applications.

entities.name: Application
entities.description: Application that requests message transport and may request additional information.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by sending DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message.
Message includes the generic message container IE.
Message includes the generic message container type IE.
Message may include the Additional information IE.
EMM entity in MME initiates the procedure upon application request.
EMM entity in UE provides contents of generic message container IE to application.
EMM entity in UE provides contents of generic message container type IE to application.
EMM entity in UE provides contents of Additional information IE to application if included.
